tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// brag dkar lha chur tshe sgrub bgyis dus mthong snang byung tshul bzhugs so//

/brag dkar lha chur tshe sgrub bgyis pa'i tshe// gnyis pa'i zhag la gzho stod gter sgrom nas// 'ongs zer byis pa gzhon nu zhig byung ba// sus btang dris pas dpal gyi ri bo nas// padmas mngags zer bdag la ci 'dod 'dri// bdag gis tshe 'di ha cang ring ba dang*| |ha cang thung ba'i mtshan ma mi 'dod kyi// rang dbang 'du bas sdod dam 'pho ba la/ /gang 'dod chog pa'i dngos grub dgos smras pas| |de lta'i dngos grub o rgyan rnam 'phrul gyi// byis pa gzhon nus sbyin zer thob pa rmis// tshe 'dir rang chos rang gis ma byas na// grogs kyi chos rnams bdag la ci phyir sman// 'on kyang 'gro kun dge la bskul ba la// nyes tshogs mchis na nongs kun bzod par bzhes// rang nyid sdod par 'dod pa'i blo byung na// kun gyis byad khas brubs kyang ci phyir 'pho// ri bo ltar brtan gnyug ma'i ngang du gnas// dbang bskur la sogs bdag gi rang 'dod kyis// khur du bkal ba min yang dgos zhes zer// mang du thos nas dam tshig rang gar 'chal| |la la'i rkyen gyis thams cad dmyal bar 'khrid// de lta'i grwa pa bdag la dgos pa med// rang nyid 'pho bar 'dod na brtan bzhugs dang*/ */rim gro srung zlog brag cha'i sgra dang 'dra// snang srid gnyug ma'i rol ba 'di mthong na// skye shi'i 'khor lo rang dbang cis mi 'du// da dung mched grogs dad zhen can 'ga' yi// yid thag bcad na rang gzhan sun phyung ba'i// rtsa ltung gis 'jigs re zhig sdod kyang sems// chags sdang khengs pa'i log rtog gis bsgribs shing*// khong khro rang dgar spyod pa'i bag med 'ga'// yi ga rdzogs phyir chos dbyings klong yangs su// 'phos kyang dus la bab pa 'dra 'am snyam// 'on kyang 'pho sdod lcang kha'i byi'u 'dra// phran bu'i rkyen gyis 'phel 'grib la ltos nas// 'dab chags 'phur ram sdod dam rang dbang 'du// chos kyi grags pas gnyug ma'i gnas lugs 'di/

/sngon nas rtogs par rlom yang gzhan rkyen gyis// ngan byed dug lnga'i spyod pa rgya mtsho'i dbus// 'khrul par zhen nas da dung ma shes pa/ /'di 'dra mthong na gnyug ma'i gnas lugs 'di// rtogs pa rang nyid ngal ba'i rgyu min nam// bdag ni shi'am gson nam ci 'dra yang*// dkon mchog gsum dang rdo rje slob dpon dag /mkhan slob pha mar bcas pa srog bzhin bzung*// bstan pa'i rtsa ba 'dul khrims mig ltar srung*// smon 'jug snying rje'i byang sems yun du brten/ /gsang sngags dngos grub kun gyi rtsa ba ste// dam tshig tshogs rnams srog la bab kyang srung*// de steng chos spyod bcu dang phar phyin drug /'khor lo gnyis dang bzhi rnams yun du sbyong*// nor bdun kun las khyad par 'phags pa'i mdzod// gzhan gyi spros pa rang nyid ngal ba'i rgyu// gnyug ma'i don 'di cis kyang mthong bar mdzod// 'gro kun pha mar shes pa'i brtse sems dang*// 'khor 'das sems su rtogs pa'i nga rgyal dang*/ /chos kun bdag med mthong ba'i brtul zhugs dang*/ /dkon mchog rten gyi skyabs su go ba dang*/ /'dus byas mi rtag sgyu mar shes pa rnams// rgyud la skyes na thar pa cis mi thob// kun gyi rtsa ba rgya che don zab pa'i// bag yod mchog la yun du gnas par mdzod// rnam grol rin chen gling gi nor bu de// len par 'dod na 'khor ba'i mtsho 'di las// dal 'byor gru chen bzang po 'di bzung la// bslab gsum mthun pa'i rlung gis rab bskyod nas// gnyug ma'i ba dan g.yo ba'i rnam dpyod kyis// dgos 'dod nor bu len pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces pa'i gnas lugs dang mched grogs la kha ta'i dal gtam 'di yang chos kyi grags pas lag dal du snag shog dal du 'jog pa bzlog par byas te rdzong khar nyams mtshar du bris pa grogs mchog rnams la bzod par gsol// //maṅga laṃ//
